component.name: Airdrop Linux
component.summary: Share files and clipboard across your devices

description.p: Share files and clipboard text through a local workspace with a desktop companion and a web app for your other devices.

ul.li: Add files individually or combine them into a ZIP archive
Browse shared files, organize folders and restore items from the workspace trash
Share clipboard text and save clipboard images as files

description.p: Connect devices inside the app using trusted Wi-Fi or optional free internet sharing through Cloudflare Quick Tunnels. No VPN account, purchased server or domain is needed. The free service has no uptime guarantee and terminates TLS. Local Wi-Fi sharing uses HTTP and a private pairing link. The setup wizard asks about background sharing after connection, with the choice editable in Settings.
Background sharing is optional and requires desktop portal permission. Without permission, sharing stops when the window closes. Choose Stop sharing and quit to stop the bundled server.

Choose files and a recipient before sending. Create verified expiring download-only links or QR invitations without granting workspace access. Improve nearby Linux discovery with scoped IPv6, unique service hostnames and authenticated saved-endpoint reconnection. Preserve existing pairing, transfer recovery and sharing providers.

Recover failed temporary internet tunnels automatically, expire stale QR codes, and reverify replacement connections. Phone verification now expires without authenticated health checks. Preserve Nearby and existing sharing providers.

Discover nearby Linux devices automatically, pair once and send files directly to a receive inbox. Accept or decline transfers, opt in to automatic acceptance per device, and resume verified chunks after interruptions. View device transfer history, progress and integrity results. Native ZIP creation now streams.
Redesigned Linux desktop with accessible light and dark themes, clearer sharing tasks, and distribution-aware updates with automatic check preferences and recovery guidance.
Receive guest uploads using an isolated, time-limited QR session. Share only explicitly selected files without granting workspace or clipboard access.
Reliably deliver bounded connection verification results before stopping the helper process. Background sharing defaults on with system permission.
Isolate sharing-address HTTPS checks in a bounded Node process so certificate work cannot block the desktop. Keep background sharing enabled by default with system permission.
Recover sharing-address DNS errors using the verified runtime trust store, without blocking the desktop. Background sharing defaults on with system permission.
Automatically recover sharing-address DNS failures, retry newly registered addresses promptly and keep sharing in the background by default with system permission.
Recover sharing-address DNS failures inside the app. Background sharing defaults on with system permission and remains configurable in Settings.
Verify internet sharing from a paired phone when desktop DNS or proxy checks fail. Show separate local service, DNS, TLS and HTTP diagnostics.
Choose Airdrop, embedded Tailscale or Wi-Fi inside the app. Internet sharing waits for tunnel registration and DNS before showing the pairing code.
